$comment: Authored 2026-07-31. Re-shoots every board that was captured under /parallel while the test-environment badge was still being transcribed. The badge ('PARALLEL SPACE · mock passkey · test') is dev chrome the shipped app never renders, and it was drawn onto seven canon boards; extract-dom-layout.js now scrubs it by data-testid, so these captures are the first clean ones. It ALSO cost these screens their region structure — the badge is a second live child of the route root, so the wrapper-descent in gen-region-maps halted one level early and every one of them collapsed to a single 'content' region.
$order: Groups run in ONE browser, in order, and both parallel-mode and hide-balance are PERSISTED preferences. So: /parallel first (it arms parallel mode for the /send group that follows), and home-hidden-balance dead last — toggling it any earlier masks the balance on every capture taken after it.

states.note: the wallet hub: balance, the three tabs, and the Activity tab's empty history — the fixture wallet has no transactions, so this IS the empty state (see the changelog entry for 2026-07-31; a populated list is not capturable today)
the Assets tab, populated from the fixture Safe's real balances
the Connections tab — one dApp session at a time, by design
a VALID details step — amount and recipient both filled, Continue enabled
the confirm step: from/to rows, chain chip, estimated network fee and the slide-to-confirm control
tap the balance to mask it — a persisted preference, which is why this is the last capture of the run
states.$why: matched on aria-label, not position: the hero carries no text of its own and its clickable INDEX differs between /wallet and /parallel, which is how this board was once recaptured with the balance still showing.
